html:
.timeline {
  min-width: 0;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  background: var(--surface);
  --sidebar-width: 320px;
}
.actions {
  min-height: 40px;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  align-items: center;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.scroll {
  overflow: auto;
  max-height: 64vh;
  position: relative;
  overscroll-behavior: contain;
}
.header,
.row {
  display: flex;
  width: calc(var(--sidebar-width) + var(--timeline-width));
  min-width: 100%;
}
.header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 4;
  min-height: 44px;
  background: var(--surface-raised);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.sidebar {
  width: var(--sidebar-width);
  flex: none;
  position: sticky;
  left: 0;
  z-index: 2;
  background: var(--surface);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 4px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.header .sidebar {
  background: var(--surface-raised);
}
.row {
  min-height: 44px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
}
.row[data-selected="true"] .sidebar {
  background: var(--selection);
}
.row[data-active="true"] .sidebar {
  box-shadow: inset 2px 0 var(--primary);
}
.track {
  position: relative;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: var(--timeline-width);
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    to right,
    transparent 0,
    transparent calc(var(--day-width) - 1px),
    var(--border) calc(var(--day-width) - 1px),
    var(--border) var(--day-width)
  );
}
.axis {
  display: flex;
  flex: 1;
}
.dayTicks > div {
  flex: none;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 11px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.axis small {
  font-size: 10px;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.axis [data-today="true"] {
  color: var(--primary);
  font-weight: 600;
  background: var(--selection);
}
.bar {
  position: absolute;
  top: 10px;
  height: 24px;
  background: var(--selection);
  border: 1px solid var(--primary);
  border-radius: 4px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  z-index: 1;
  min-width: 8px;
  color: var(--foreground);
}
.bar[data-single="true"] {
  border-style: dashed;
  background: var(--surface-raised);
}
.barMain {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
  font-size: 11px;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 0 4px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.barMain:disabled {
  cursor: default;
}
.barMain[data-draggable="true"] {
  cursor: grab;
}
.barMain:active[data-draggable="true"] {
  cursor: grabbing;
}
.barMain:focus-visible,
.handle:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.handle {
  width: 8px;
  flex: none;
  cursor: ew-resize;
  color: var(--primary);
  font-size: 10px;
}
.bar[data-clip-start="true"] {
  border-left-style: dashed;
}
.bar[data-clip-end="true"] {
  border-right-style: dashed;
}
.continueStart,
.continueEnd {
  font-size: 12px;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.todayLine {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  bottom: 0;
  width: 1px;
  background: var(--primary);
  opacity: 0.4;
  pointer-events: none;
}
.missing,
.invalid {
  display: block;
  padding: 12px;
  font-size: 12px;
  color: var(--muted-foreground);
}
.invalid {
  color: var(--destructive);
}
.expanded {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 8px;
  z-index: 35;
}
.expanded .scroll {
  max-height: calc(100dvh - 100px);
}
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .timeline {
    --sidebar-width: 260px;
  }
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .handle {
    display: none;
  }
  .bar {
    height: 44px;
    top: 2px;
  }
  .row {
    min-height: 48px;
  }
  .barMain {
    min-width: 44px;
  }
  .bar {
    min-width: 44px;
  }
  .sidebar {
    min-height: 48px;
  }
}

.sidebar > div:first-child {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}

.axis {
  flex-direction: column;
}
.months,
.dayTicks {
  display: flex;
}
.months span {
  flex: none;
  text-align: left;
  padding: 0 4px;
  font-size: 11px;
  border-right: 1px solid var(--border);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.months {
  height: 16px;
}
.dayTicks {
  min-height: 28px;
}
